answer_1.quote: Each of the 93 original arguments was summarized three times, and GPT-4 was used to generate five 'more persuasive' versions of the first two summaries and three 'less persuasive' versions of the third summary.
datasets: Curated set of 93 root arguments from advocacy websites

answer_4.quote: we deployed a survey on Amazon's Mechanical Turk (MTurk) platform to evaluate the arguments. In this survey, each respondent was shown a pair of arguments about veganism and then asked to select the more persuasive argument.
answer_4.guideline: Respondents were asked to choose the more persuasive argument in a pairwise forced-choice design.
